results.rationale: Consistency: the board and wood background remain, but the central O becomes an X and an unrequested O is added at bottom middle. Instruction: several Xs are added across the middle row while the actual winning top-middle square remains empty, so this is not the requested single winning move. Knowledge: the altered board also gives O a full bottom row and changes existing play illegally; instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: the colored symbols, beveled grid and wood texture are visually coherent and clean.

Consistency: the original adapter remains on the left, an unrelated second adapter is introduced, and the cable's connector details change. Instruction: the original adapter is not moved into the cable loop; the added block sits outside its center. Quality: the white product forms and shadows are coherent, but the right cable connector has an unusually blank, featureless tip.
